raw_segments.text: Kent, good king, that must approve the common saw, thou out of heaven's benediction calms
Approach, thou beacon to this under globe, that by thy comfortable beams I may peruse
Nothing almost sees miracles but misery.
I know tease from Cordelia, who hath most fortunately been informed of my obscured course,
and shall find time from this enormous state, seeking to give losses their remedies.
All weary and orwatched, take vantage, heavy eyes, not to behold this shameful lodging.
Fortune, good night, smile once more, turn thy wheel.
